theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 57 群

items.pos: adj. 支援的；輔助的
items.colloc: supporting document 證明文件 | supporting role 配角
items.distinct: supported 被支援的（被動）| support 支援（動詞）
ex: Please provide all supporting documents for the claim.
請提供理賠的所有證明文件。
She plays a supporting role in this department.
她在這個部門扮演輔助角色。
We need supporting evidence to validate the report.
我們需要輔助證據來驗證這份報告。

items.pos: v. 懷疑；察覺
items.colloc: suspect of 懷疑涉嫌 | strongly suspect 強烈懷疑
items.distinct: suspicion 懷疑（名詞）| suspicious 可疑的（形容詞）
ex: I suspect that the system has been compromised.
我懷疑系統已經遭到了入侵。
Management suspects the error was caused by staff.
管理層懷疑該錯誤是由員工造成的。
Do you suspect any foul play in the deal?
你懷疑這筆交易有任何弊端嗎？

items.pos: n. 平板電腦；藥片
items.colloc: tablet computer 平板電腦 | take a tablet 服用藥片
items.distinct: pad 便條紙 | laptop 筆記型電腦
ex: The sales team uses tablets for customer presentations.
業務團隊使用平板電腦進行客戶簡報。
He takes a tablet for his headache every morning.
他每天早上服用一顆藥片治療頭痛。
Have you updated the software on your tablet?
你更新過平板電腦的軟體了嗎？

items.pos: v. 撕裂；扯破 | n. 眼淚；裂口
items.colloc: tear down 拆除 | in tears 流淚
items.distinct: tare 皮重（與重量有關）| tier 層次
ex: Don't tear the contract before reading it carefully.
閱讀合約前請勿將其撕毀。
The construction crew will tear down the old office.
施工團隊將拆除舊辦公室。
She was in tears after receiving the bad news.
收到壞消息後她流下了眼淚。

items.pos: adj. 有效的；顯露真相的
items.colloc: telling detail 顯露真相的細節 | telling argument 有力的論點
items.distinct: told 告知（過去式）| tell 告訴（動詞）
ex: The silence from the manager was quite telling.
經理的沉默說明了一切。
He made a telling point during the board meeting.
他在董事會中提出了一個有力的論點。
These statistics provide a telling picture of growth.
這些數據呈現了成長的真實樣貌。

items.pos: v. 追蹤；勾勒 | n. 痕跡；蹤跡
items.colloc: trace back 追溯 | without a trace 無影無蹤
items.distinct: track 軌道；追蹤 | trail 蹤跡；小徑
ex: We can trace the origin of the shipment easily.
我們可以輕易追蹤貨物的來源。
The police found a trace of evidence at the scene.
警方在現場發現了一絲痕跡。
Can you trace the error in the accounting file?
你能找出會計檔案中的錯誤根源嗎？

items.pos: n. 試用；審判；考驗
items.colloc: free trial 免費試用 | on trial 在審判中
items.distinct: training 訓練 | trip 旅行
ex: Our company offers a thirty-day free software trial.
我們公司提供三十天的免費軟體試用。
The new product is currently undergoing a trial phase.
新產品目前正處於試用階段。
They have been on trial for the fraud case.
他們正因詐欺案接受審判。

items.pos: adj. 無法接受的；不合意的
items.colloc: totally unacceptable 完全無法接受 | find unacceptable 認為不妥
items.distinct: unexpected 未預期的 | unbearable 無法忍受的
ex: Such poor performance is unacceptable for this team.
這種績效表現對本團隊來說無法接受。
The delay in delivery is completely unacceptable to us.
延遲交貨對我們而言完全無法接受。
We find the proposed terms entirely unacceptable.
我們認為提出的條件完全無法接受。

items.pos: n. 失業；失業率
items.colloc: unemployment rate 失業率 | high unemployment 高失業率
items.distinct: employment 就業 | underemployment 就業不足
ex: The unemployment rate has dropped significantly this quarter.
本季的失業率已顯著下降。
Rising unemployment is a major concern for the government.
失業率攀升是政府的主要憂慮。
He has been facing unemployment for six months.
他已經失業六個月了。

items.pos: n. 風險投資；事業 | v. 冒險嘗試
items.colloc: joint venture 合資企業 | business venture 商業冒險
items.distinct: adventure 冒險活動 | venue 場地
ex: They decided to start a joint venture in Asia.
他們決定在亞洲展開合資企業。
This new business venture requires significant capital investment.
這項新的商業投資需要大額資本注入。
I would not venture to guess the final outcome.
我不敢貿然猜測最終結果。

items.pos: adj. 訪問的；客座的
items.colloc: visiting professor 客座教授 | visiting scholar 訪問學者
ex: We are hosting a visiting scholar from Germany.
我們正在接待一位來自德國的訪問學者。
The visiting manager will arrive at ten o'clock.
訪問的經理將於十點抵達。
He is currently a visiting fellow at the university.
他目前是該大學的訪問研究員。

items.pos: adj. 被通緝的；被徵求的 | v. 想要（want過去式）
items.colloc: wanted poster 通緝海報 | help wanted 徵才
items.distinct: wanting 缺乏的 | wanting 想要的
ex: The company has a wanted ad for engineers.
公司刊登了徵求工程師的廣告。
He is wanted for questioning regarding the fraud.
他因該詐欺案被通緝以進行問話。
Is there anything else wanted for the meeting?
會議還有需要準備什麼嗎？

items.pos: adj. 願意的；樂意的
items.colloc: willing to do 樂意做某事 | perfectly willing 非常願意
items.distinct: willful 任性的 | wilting 凋謝的
ex: Are you willing to work overtime this weekend?
你願意這個週末加班嗎？
The management is willing to negotiate the contract.
管理層願意商討合約內容。
She is always willing to help her colleagues.
她總是樂於幫助同事。

items.pos: adj. 吸引人的；引人入勝的
items.colloc: absorbing book 引人入勝的書 | absorbing task 令人專注的工作
items.distinct: absorbed 專注的；被吸收的 | absorb 吸收（動詞）
ex: The lecture was so absorbing that time flew by.
演講太精彩了，時間過得飛快。
This project is an absorbing challenge for our team.
這個專案對我們團隊來說是一項吸引人的挑戰。
He found the research topic extremely absorbing.
他發現這個研究主題極其引人入勝。

items.pos: n. 航空器；飛機
items.colloc: commercial aircraft 商用飛機 | aircraft industry 航空工業
items.distinct: airliner 客機 | spacecraft 太空船
ex: The new aircraft will reduce fuel consumption by ten percent.
新型飛機將減少百分之十的燃油消耗。
The company manufactures parts for commercial aircraft.
這家公司製造商用飛機的零件。
Several aircraft are parked on the runway now.
現在有幾架飛機停在跑道上。

items.pos: adj. 驚訝的；感到驚奇的
items.colloc: amazed at 驚訝於 | be amazed to see 對…感到驚訝
items.distinct: amazing 令人驚奇的 | amazement 驚奇（名詞）
ex: I was amazed by the efficiency of the new system.
我對新系統的高效率感到驚訝。
The CEO was amazed to see the high sales figures.
執行長看到高銷售數字時感到非常驚奇。
Everyone was amazed at the quick project completion.
每個人都對專案如此快速完成感到驚訝。

items.pos: adj. 被預期的 | v. 預期（anticipate過去式）
items.colloc: highly anticipated 高度預期的 | as anticipated 如預期
items.distinct: anticipating 預期（現在分詞）| anticipation 預期（名詞）
ex: The launch of the product was highly anticipated.
這款產品的發布受到高度期待。
We achieved the goals as anticipated last month.
我們如上個月預期般達成了目標。
The anticipated costs are within the company budget.
預期成本在公司預算範圍內。

items.pos: adj. 有吸引力的；迷人的
items.colloc: visually appealing 視覺上吸引人的 | highly appealing 非常吸引人的
items.distinct: appeal 吸引力；呼籲 | appealed 呼籲（過去式）
ex: The flexible working hours are very appealing to staff.
彈性工時對員工非常有吸引力。
We need a more appealing design for our website.
我們需要更具吸引力的網站設計。
The compensation package is quite appealing to candidates.
這份薪資福利對求職者相當有吸引力。

items.pos: adv. 嚴重地；非常地 | 惡劣地
items.colloc: badly needed 非常需要 | badly damaged 嚴重受損
items.distinct: bad 壞的（形容詞）| bed 床
ex: Our office computers are badly in need of updates.
我們的辦公室電腦非常需要升級。
The shipment was badly damaged during the transport.
貨物在運輸過程中嚴重受損。
They badly want to win the new contract.
他們非常渴望贏得這份新合約。

items.pos: v. 慶祝；讚揚
items.colloc: celebrate success 慶祝成功 | celebrate an anniversary 慶祝週年
items.distinct: celebration 慶祝活動 | celebrity 名人
ex: We will celebrate the anniversary of the company soon.
我們很快將慶祝公司成立週年。
The team met to celebrate their latest achievement.
團隊聚在一起慶祝他們最新的成就。
Let us celebrate by having a dinner together.
讓我們一起吃晚餐慶祝一下。
